name: Features, explorer
description: Features as a list of choices beside a panel that shows the chosen one with its screenshot and text. On phones every feature shows in full under its name.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Next week's rota, done before the kettle boils

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Larder is rota software for cafés, bars and restaurants with five to fifty staff. Pick a feature to see it.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: A text message goes out the evening before every shift.

default.name: Drag-and-drop rota
default.text: Build the week by dragging shifts onto names. Larder warns you about clashes, short rests and anyone creeping past 48 hours.

image.alt: A weekly rota with colour-coded shifts for nine members of staff

default.name: Shift swaps
default.text: Someone offers a shift from their phone, a colleague picks it up and you approve it with one tap. No more group chat at midnight.

image.alt: A phone showing a shift swap waiting for approval

default.name: Clock in at the till
default.text: A four digit code at the start and end of each shift. Hours go straight to the timesheet, rounded the way your contracts say.

image.alt: A tablet beside the till showing a clock-in keypad

default.name: Payroll export
default.text: On the last Friday of the month, send approved hours, holiday and tips to Xero, Sage or a plain spreadsheet.

image.alt: A payroll summary with hours and tips for each person
